settings.content: Single source for the bundle prices shown on the product page, final CTA, sticky bar and cart. The discount amounts here MUST equal your Shopify automatic discounts (see README → Discount setup). The cart always shows Shopify's real totals.

settings.label: Discount per mask, in cents

settings.label: Add to cart error

settings.content: Leave the day fields empty to hide the estimate. All days are business days (Mon–Fri, minus the non-shipping dates below). Use your real worst case, not the supplier's best case.

settings.label: Transit to customer — min business days
Transit to customer — max business days
Daily order cutoff hour (0–23)
settings.info: Orders after this hour count as next business day. Empty = no cutoff.

settings.label: Cutoff time zone
settings.info: IANA name, e.g. America/New_York. Empty = visitor's own time zone.

settings.label: Non-shipping dates
settings.info: YYYY-MM-DD, separated by commas or new lines (holidays).

settings.label: Estimate text
settings.info: [dates] = date range

settings.content: Shows "order by" only while an order placed today still arrives BEFORE the event date in the worst case. Hides itself automatically after the cutoff.

settings.label: Event name
settings.info: e.g. Halloween

settings.label: Event date
settings.info: YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-10-31

settings.label: Banner text
settings.default: Order by [cutoff] to get it before [event]

settings.content: Set Cart → Cart type to "Drawer" for these features.

settings.label: Free shipping threshold, in cents
settings.info: Must equal the free shipping rate condition in Settings → Shipping. Empty = hide the bar.

settings.label: Upgrade text
settings.info: [price] = extra cost, [amount] = savings. Savings part is removed automatically if tier 2 has no discount.

settings.label: Add-on upsell product
settings.info: Hidden when already in the cart. Use a product with one variant.
